Fills the depressions (pits) of a digital elevation model, raising the cells that have no downhill neighbour, so that from every cell water can flow down to the border of the map. It is the first step of most hydro-geomorphological analyses.

**Toolbox folder:** Dem Manipulation<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Dem manipulation, Geomorphology, Depressions, Pits<br>
**Authors:** David Tarboton, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Pitfiller`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file |  |  | The digital elevation model. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
